name: blenderlab
title: BlenderLab
author: HydraOps
description: The official MCP server from Blender Lab (Blender Foundation): run Python in your Blender, inspect the scene and the blend file, search the bundled Python API reference and user manual, capture the window and render.

notes: Blender 5.1 or newer, open while the agent works.
Git (uvx fetches the server from Blender's repository); the first start takes about a minute.

The official "MCP" add-on from Blender Lab, installed and enabled in Blender, with "Allow Online Access" on in Blender's System preferences and its server started (the add-on's preferences have a start button and an auto-start option).
It uses port 9876. If the community "MCP for Blender" add-on is still installed in Blender, disable it or move it to another port; this connection's port is BLENDER_MCP_PORT.

setup.then: Download that file and drag it into the Blender window (or Edit → Preferences → Get Extensions → Install from Disk), then enable "MCP" and start its server from the add-on's preferences.

tips: Blender's own warning applies: the server runs model-written Python in your Blender with only a light guard. Keep backups of files you care about.
